title: a11y_scan input
description: Checks declared foreground/background pairs derived from shared component CSS against current built tokens for every registered brand and theme, including team brands. With a UiSchema, renders through the shared HTML renderer and checks document language/title, one main landmark, unique IDs, ARIA reference targets, control names/labels, image alternatives, chart SVG name/description, and heading names/order. Reports unresolved inherited surfaces, dynamic CSS, alpha compositing and OS colours as unmeasured. Does not check browser-computed colour/layout, keyboard/focus interaction or screen-reader behavior; no complete WCAG conformance claim.

apply.description: When true, write the a11y report artifact to the artifacts directory.

schema.description: Render this UiSchema in memory and inspect its HTML; select declared token pairs for its rendered components.
